domain:skills#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwTZvo7tAGwbbRW2b8

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `fe605fb6c16d11db501eee42cbcc9afce7bbf701`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0019-app-as-consumer-unit.md, docs/adr/0130-release-artifact-as-co-ownership-boundary.md, skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md + none

Inputs read: card #32809 body and its 3 comments (triage 6834927956, claim 6836140314, dev report 6836872807) and the record it cites (PR #32792 contract review, comment 6833950860, ③); PR #32846 body, its file list (4 files) and the net diff against `main` at this head (merge base `2ca09de5`; `main` is now `c04aa295` and its two later commits touch none of the four paths, nor `stack.zod.ts`, nor the ratchet script); the 42 check-runs on this head. Read, not reviewed: `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` and `stack.test.ts` on `main`, `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (the ceiling row), the eval file, `skills/objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md`, card #32810, the pulls API for #32792, and hotcrm#2417, hotcrm#2430 and the hotcrm tree at `41d301a7bd`. The changeset is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`.

Check-runs at 2026-11-12T21:55Z: 17 `success`, 16 `skipped`, none failed, 9 `in_progress`. Green among them: `Check Changeset`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Type Check · workspace`. Still running: `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · ESLint`, `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Type Check · source gates`, `Build Core`, `Test Core (1/8)`, `Test Core (2/8)`. The skill and ADR gate families (token ratchet, skill-docs, skill-refs, ADR links, anchors and index) sit in the lint jobs still running, so their verdict is not in yet. This record judges the design; the seat reads those nine conclusions before the queue, and a red one there is a gate failure this PASS does not cover.

### ① Derived judgments

- **No accept set moves.** The diff holds no code, no schema, no test and no generated artifact. `defineStack`, `composeStacks` and every validator are byte-identical to `main`. Right: the card orders prose and records only.
- **Published surface: one paragraph and one pitfall tail of `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`** (shipped in `@objectstack/skills`). The App Navigation paragraph now states the single-app rule for `type: 'app'` and `type: 'module'` packages alike. Right: it is what `validateSingleApp` enforces on `main` (see ④).
- **One sentence of teaching is removed** ("a `type: 'module'` package may carry its own app") and replaced by a stricter one ("each further app goes in a module of its own"). Right: the permission is still stated, and the removed wording was the one that let a reader infer several apps per module.
- **Common Pitfalls 2 loses "set it only when you want an explicit grid position".** Right: a restatement, judged in ④.
- **Eval file not edited.** Right: case 2 still grades the rule (see ④).
- **`docs/adr/**` is not published.** The two ADR edits change no package content. The ADR index rows in `docs/adr/README.md` truncate the status at "proposed 2…", a prefix this diff leaves unchanged, so the index needs no regeneration.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/32809-ui-skill-one-app-per-package.md` declares `@objectstack/skills` patch. The diff publishes a prose correction to one skill file: no new skill, no removed section, no change to what any tool accepts. Patch matches. `Check Changeset` is green on this head.

Clause-②: no. The line is present and identical on the PR body and in the changeset, with `Metadata-protocol: none` beside it on both. Correct: nothing is widened or narrowed here; the narrowing itself shipped in #32792 under its own declaration. The review tier comes from the governed paths (`skills/**`, `docs/adr/**`), not from this line.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **The paying cut sits in Common Pitfalls 2, outside § App Navigation.** Answered: the claim (6836140314) names "a same-file cut paying any added line" in its file surface, and card work item 3 asks only that the line be paid for. Inside the claim.
- **ADR-0019's "Enforced today, and not yet" paragraph is kept as written, with a dated paragraph added after it.** Answered, accepted. The card said "record it with the merge commit" and did not order a rewrite. The old paragraph is pinned to `main` at `8bfbc4ed` and stays a true reading of that commit; the new one opens by saying so. A reader who stops at the old paragraph's "not yet enforced" is caught by the status line and by the very next paragraph.
- **The new ADR-0019 paragraph names two shapes still unjudged, with #32810.** Answered, correct. #32810 is open (`priority:p1`, `pm:dispatched`, `domain:spec`) and its body names exactly these two shapes: the flat `composeStacks` under the default `manifest: 'last'`, and a hand-built `packages[]` body. The record claims no more than the enforcement.
- **ADR-0130's row is annotated in the row, original text kept.** Answered, accepted. It follows the same additive convention, and the card allowed "amend or annotate".
- **Second commit `fe605fb6`: the HotCRM split moves from Pending to landed.** Verified against hotcrm. hotcrm#2430 is merged (2026-11-12T08:11:26Z, merge commit `41d301a7bd8e8544f274802dccf1ed81490977cc`) and hotcrm#2417 is closed as completed two seconds later. On the hotcrm tree at that commit: `CrmApp` in `src/sales` (the `type: 'app'` package), `ServiceApp` in `src/service` and `MarketingApp` in `src/marketing` (both `type: 'module'`), composed in `objectstack.config.ts` with `manifest: 'preserve'`. "Each in a package of its own" is true. The fold is outside the card's text and rides the seat's word; it stays inside the one line this PR already edits. Note for the seat: hotcrm#2430's body says the hosted publish waits for cloud#3636. The status line says "Landed in HotCRM" and makes no claim about hosted, so it holds.
- **The PR body is stale against this head.** Its Verification section names head `9e4c8483`, and its Acceptance note "Left stale in the ADR-0019 status line, not touched here" is now false, since `fe605fb6` touches that clause. The seat owes the body patch. Not a finding on the tree.
- **#32664** (ADR-0130 D2 pointer lines) waits behind this card. This diff touches ADR-0130 at the §1.5 row only. No conflict.
- **Dev deviation: a whole-tree build to clear three exit-3 gates; template item 6 ticked with `packages/spec` untouched.** Process notes for the seat's ACCEPT. Neither changes the tree.

### ④ Design judgment

**`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`** — holds against the code on `main` and against the eval.

- "`defineStack` refuses a second app in a `type: 'app'` and a `type: 'module'` package alike": true. `SINGLE_APP_PACKAGE_TYPES` (`stack.zod.ts:2611`) is `app` and `module`; `validateSingleApp` (2630 to 2643) returns a finding when either type carries more than one app; its single caller (6897) throws `StackSingleAppViolationError`, code `STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION`. PR #32792 is merged (2026-11-12T20:46:53Z, merge commit `9ae829108c10fae3c14b6094140dd8ece4bfb3cd`, an ancestor of `main`).
- The citation "D3 as amended" is the citation the code and its finding carry.
- The remedy "each further app goes in a module of its own" is the finding's own ("move each other app into a 'module' package of its own"). "With the objects it shows" is the card's ordered wording and the eval's. "Served under that module's package id and gone when it is disabled" restates the amendment's reasons 1 and 3.
- The eval, case 2 ("a second app for the support team, who work the same objects"): its three graded statements are each still taught. At most one app per package (the heading and first sentence); the support team as a `requiredPermissions`-gated group inside the app (the paragraph's last sentence, unchanged); a support product with objects of its own carries its app in its own `type: 'module'` package of the suite (the new remedy sentence, now stated outright where the old text only permitted it). All seven `must_contain` tokens are present in the skill's non-eval files. No eval edit is needed.
- The paying cut is a real restatement. What remains reads "`layout` is optional: omit it and the widget auto-flows", after "The grid-placement field is `layout: { x, y, w, h }`". The deleted tail said the converse of "omit it" and taught nothing more.
- Ratchet held, no raise. The file is 15276 bytes on this head, 15256 priced after the 20-byte stamp line, and `ceil(15256 / 4)` is 3814 against a ceiling row of 3814 that the diff does not edit. Before: 15253 priced, also 3814. Lines 301 before and after. Headroom is zero, which bounds every fix below.
- Attempts to break it: the unqualified "refuses" against `strict: false` (the old sentence was equally unqualified, and strict is the default); a module with zero apps (allowed, and the sentence does not say otherwise); another restatement of the app-only rule elsewhere in the bundle (none: no other `skills/**` file states the rule); the flat composition, which yields S1.

Findings on this file:

- **S1 (should-fix, carried by #32810, not owed by this head)** — the remedy does not say the suite must be composed with `manifest: 'preserve'`. No skill names that option; the only mention of `composeStacks` in the bundle is `objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md`, which says "read the schema before reaching for it". An author who follows the new sentence and composes flat gets one package id carrying several apps, with no refusal today, and "served under that module's package id" is then false. The old sentence had the same gap, the card ordered this wording, and the file has no token headroom. #32810 changes what an author must write here and the dev's report already notes that it owes its own Skills-docs follow-up. The seat confirms that line is on #32810.
- **N1 (nit)** — "with the objects it shows" reads as if a module's app shows only its own objects. Under reason 2 an app's own navigation names only its package's objects, but another package may contribute entries to it (HotCRM's Service app shows Accounts that way). The ADR says the placement is "argued, not checked". Card wording, kept.

**`docs/adr/0019-app-as-consumer-unit.md`** — status line and the new paragraph are true against `main`.

- Status line: the module check is under "Landed in spec" with #32586, the date and `9ae829108c`, which is the merge commit of #32792. The HotCRM clause is verified in ③. The one remaining Pending item (the Console marketplace filling `packageType`) is unchanged. The Amended clause is untouched, and its closing sentence about the earlier Pending wording still reads true.
- "Enforced for modules since 2026-11-12", claim by claim: `validateSingleApp` judges the types of `SINGLE_APP_PACKAGE_TYPES`, `app` and `module` (true); the same `STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION` (true, one error class); the finding names the package, each app and the remedy (true, lines 2638 to 2642); other types, no manifest and `strict: false` not judged (true: line 2632, and the check is on the strict path); `stack.test.ts` keeps the `driver` pin (true: "does not constrain package types other than app and module" uses a `driver` manifest); the check reads one `defineStack` call (true, one caller); the two unjudged shapes match #32810's body; the placement sentence stands (true, nothing in #32792 checks placement).
- D3 as amended is cited correctly throughout, and the paragraph sits inside the amendment block, between "Enforced today, and not yet" and "Not decided here", where a reader of the old paragraph meets it next.
- Not said, and correctly so: whether a `type: 'plugin'` package is held to one app. The #32792 review escalated it as undecided; "every other package type ... not judged" states the fact without ruling on it.

Finding:

- **N2 (nit)** — the record writes "#32586 ... merged as `9ae829108c`" in the status line and the new paragraph, and ADR-0130's row follows it. #32586 is the card; the merged thing is PR #32792. The commit is right and its subject carries "(#32792)", so the trail resolves. Naming the PR would make it exact.

**`docs/adr/0130-release-artifact-as-co-ownership-boundary.md`** — the §1.5 row holds.

- The original cell text is kept. The note dates the reading (2026-09-01, the record's date as ADR-0019 also gives it), says since when it is false (2026-11-12, #32586, `9ae829108c`), and says what the function does now: holds a `type: 'module'` package to at most one app as well, and returns `[]` for every type but those two. Each is true against `stack.zod.ts:2632`.
- The table still parses: the note adds no pipe character, the anchor column `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts#validateSingleApp` is unchanged and still resolves, and the relative link to ADR-0019 is a file that exists.
- The section header says "Re-verified in this worktree"; the note is dated in the row, so the row no longer reads as a present-tense fact. Good.

No must-fix. One should-fix (S1), carried by #32810 and not owed by this head. Two nits (N1, N2), left as accepted deviations: a fix moves the head and N1 has no token headroom to land in.

## 维护者速读(席位终稿)

- **改了什么**:`objectstack-ui` 技能「App Navigation」一段写明:应用包(`type: 'app'`)和模块包(`type: 'module'`)都至多一个应用,多出的应用各放进一个自带对象的模块包。ADR-0019 状态行和新增一段、ADR-0130 §1.5 一行事实同步记下「模块包检查已在 #32792 落地」;状态行顺带把已落地的 HotCRM 拆分(hotcrm#2430)从 Pending 挪到 Landed。
- **为什么改**:#32792 之后 `defineStack` 也拒模块包里的第二个应用。技能原句只说应用包,客户的 agent 会以为模块包能放多个,写出来在 `os validate` / `os build` 才被拒。
- **风险与回滚**:只改技能文案、两份 ADR 和 changeset,不动代码;技能 token 3814/3814,用同文件删一句重复话付清,上限没抬。回滚即撤本 PR。
- **先看**:`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`「At most one App per package」一段;ADR-0019 状态行与「Enforced for modules since 2026-11-12」一段。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs | grep objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` 读到 `3814 tokens (ceiling 3814; headroom 0)`。
- **需要你做的**:批准(Tier H,`skills/**` 与 `docs/adr/**` 需审批人)。契约复审 PASS 6837025180,`Head-sha` `fe605fb6c16d11db501eee42cbcc9afce7bbf701`。
- **席位意见**:ACCEPT。p1;S1(套件组合须 `manifest: 'preserve'`)归 #32810 带走,不压本 PR。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:skills#1 · head `fe605fb6c16d11db501eee42cbcc9afce7bbf701`

- **形态:** draft → main;首行 `Fixes #32809`(无其它卡号挨闭合关键词);作者 `objectstack-fleet[bot]`(经中继)。
- **前提实测:** 认领 6836140314 读数成立;#32792 已合(`9ae829108c`,`main` 祖先);`main` 自 merge base 起未碰本 PR 四个路径。
- **门禁 check-runs(现 head):** 45 个,29 success · 16 skipped · 0 failed;复审时在跑的九个(lint 三组、ESLint、类型检查两组、Build Core、Test Core 1–2/8)全部完成绿。
- **契约复审:** CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER PASS 6837025180,同 head;must-fix 0 · should-fix 1(S1,归 #32810,本 head 不欠)· nit 2(N1 卡定措辞、N2「#32586 merged as」宜写 PR #32792,均不推新 head)。
- **changeset(TIER_DEFAULT,席位逐句核):** `'@objectstack/skills': patch`;正文与 diff 对得上,`Clause-②: no`、`Metadata-protocol: none` 与 PR 正文一致;ADR 不发布。
